For [platform](/docs/shell/commands/categories/platform/).

<div class='command-title'>Delay for a specified amount of time.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> sleep {flags} (duration) ...rest```

## Parameters

 -  `duration`: Time to sleep.
 -  `...rest`: Additional time duration to sleep.


## Input/output types:

| input   | output  |
| ------- | ------- |
| nothing | nothing |
## Examples

Sleep for 1 second.
```nu
> sleep 1sec

```

Use multiple arguments to write a duration with multiple units, which is unsupported by duration literals.
```nu
> sleep 1min 30sec

```

Send output after 1 second.
```nu
> sleep 1sec; echo done

```
